title: session
summary: MSUI parses ordinary and transport-bearing SMSG_TRANSFER_PENDING bodies, the one-byte SMSG_TRANSFER_ABORTED reason, and the exact packed-datetime/f32 SMSG_LOGIN_SETTIMESPEED body. The game loop raises or cancels the transfer curtain at the ordered packet edge and advances atmosphere/minimap time from the server-owned WorldClock.

openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: the one-byte abort reason is strictly parsed, cancels a pending curtain/portal handoff, updates travel status, and emits player-visible transfer feedback.
2026-08-22: the exact packed-datetime + f32 timescale body is strictly parsed and applied to WorldClock at the packet receive stamp; atmosphere and GameTime consume that advancing server clock.
